body.x: Neet Products(www.neetproducts.com) announced 'Neet Sleeve' at 'Showstoppers' of CES 2014, the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Neet Sleeve is made for people who has had the experience of fighting with the wires and cords on their electronics. For example, cords of earphones get tangled, they catch on things when you're working out – they're inconvenient and frustrating. With this product, you can slip easily over wires and cords and prevent tangling. It's adjustable, giving you freedom and control and organizing the mess with one Neet sleeve for wire management.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
